meta.name: consciousness-council
meta.description: Run a multi-perspective Mind Council deliberation on any question, decision, or creative challenge. Use this skill whenever the user wants diverse viewpoints, needs help making a tough decision, asks for a council/panel/board discussion, wants to explore a problem from multiple angles, requests devil's advocate analysis, or says things like "what would different experts think about this", "help me think through this from all sides", "council mode", "mind council", or "deliberate on this". Also trigger when the user faces a dilemma, trade-off, or complex choice with no obvious answer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从多角度探讨任何问题，做出更明智的决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常面临复杂问题需要多方观点
copy.tagline_en: Deliberate any question from multiple perspectives for better decisions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often face complex decisions and want diverse viewpoints

howto.what: 面对问题或抉择时,Claude 会从 12 种思维原型中挑 4~6 位组成「心智议会」,逐位给出立场、推理、所见的风险与意外洞察,最后输出综合:共识点、核心矛盾、盲区、建议路径与置信度。
howto.when: 当你想要多角度观点、需要帮忙做困难决定,或提到「council mode」「mind council」「帮我从各方面想想」等说法时触发。

say.text: 用议会模式帮我判断:我该不该换工作?
say.note: 会挑几位原型成员展开多角度讨论

say.text: 深度议会:我们要不要自建技术架构?
say.note: 用 6 位成员,推理更长

say.text: 开匿名议会讨论这个定价策略
say.note: 综合前不揭示各成员身份,减少先入为主

howto.what_en: When you bring a question or decision, Claude picks 4-6 archetypes as a Mind Council; each gives a position, reasoning, key risk and surprising insight, then it synthesizes convergence, core tension, blind spot, recommended path and confidence.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want diverse viewpoints, help with a tough decision, or say "council mode", "mind council", or "help me think through this from all sides".

say_en.text: Run council mode: should I leave my job to start a company?
Deep council: should we build our own tech stack?
Anonymous council on our pricing strategy
